name: smirnov-labs
description: Skills for Claude from Smirnov Labs, packaged as plugins.

plugins.name: smart-goals-coach
plugins.description: A guided coaching session that turns a fuzzy wish into one to three SMART goals you can start this week, with a goal card, first step and if-then plan.

plugins.name: vet-counterparty
plugins.description: Checks whether an unfamiliar company, vendor or cold-email sender is what it claims to be. Claude looks up the domain's age and mail records, searches for copied website text, reviews and named people, and gives a verdict with the evidence behind it.
